description: Bounded integer-key traces for the two pinned linear probing table snapshots.

source_environment.standard_library: Apple libc++ (default for the pinned target)
source_environment.int_hash: std::hash<int> returns identity for keys in this contract on the pinned target
source_environment.source_equivalence_scope: Cross-library or cross-toolchain executions are outside this source-equivalence claim.

input.record_shape: Opcodes 0–3 consume an opcode and one key; opcode 4 consumes only its opcode. The packed array must end exactly after the declared operation count.
input.add_duplicates: Allowed; each duplicate occupies another probe slot.
input.remove_missing: Invalid input; the source writes to the notPresent sentinel index and corrupts state when a key is absent.
input.find_semantics: Opcode 2 reports whether searchingProber matched the requested key during linear probing; it does not reproduce the CLI wrapper’s follow-up table[notPresent] rendering check, which can misreport a miss when slot 0 is occupied.

output.hash_record: The raw positive key, matching std::hash<int> identity behavior in the pinned target environment.

workspace.reason: Sixteen adds from initial capacity 2 grow to capacity 64; sixteen displays each emit 66 words, plus 32 words from adds, for 1,088 output words.
